summary: Scheduled snapshot embed strips tracehook headers after retention roll-over
description:
Issue summary:
Customers using embedded dashboard snapshots (scheduled snapshots that are later embedded via signed URLs or iframes) are intermittently losing tracing context when a retention compaction/rollover occurs. The tracing_hook header that the snapshot service attaches to outbound trace links is being stripped in the snapshot render flow after retention compaction windows run, which results in:
- dashboard alert emails containing trace links that no longer include tracehook headers (trace links 404 or open a generic trace search)
- embedded snapshots losing trace-anchor behavior (clicking trace ID opens console with empty filters)
Impact:
- Customer-facing: NimbleHealth reports inability to correlate alerts to traces during peak jobs for their scheduled reports (enterprise SLA impacted). Several alerts escalated to SRE because alert email trace-links returned 404s.
- Scope: Reported for 3 orgs across us-east with scheduled snapshot cadence daily between 02:00-03:30 UTC (coincides with retention compaction batch).
Observed behavior:
- When a scheduled snapshot executes shortly after retention compaction, the final rendered HTML payload served to the snapshot pipeline removes the X-Tracehook header from internal trace link generation.
- Console dashboards viewed interactively are unaffected; this appears isolated to snapshot rendering / export path.
Expected behavior:
- Snapshot-generated embeds and alert emails should preserve the tracing_hook header or embed equivalent trace-anchor tokens so trace links continue to route into the console with context intact.
Steps to reproduce:
1) Configure an embedded dashboard snapshot with tracehook-enabled links (customer uses TraceHook policy v2).
2) Schedule snapshot to run within 10 minutes after a retention compaction job (compaction runs between 02:00-03:30 UTC in prod us-east).
3) Observe generated snapshot payload and alert email; follow the trace link.
4) Note whether the tracehook token is present in the link query parameters or headers; verify trace page opens with filters.
Relevant logs / artifacts:
- Example alert email trace link (redacted): https://console.redwood.ai/trace?id=abc123&tracehook= (tracehook missing)
- Snapshot rendering service logs (prod-us-east snapshot-svc) attached below in comments.
- Customer-provided screenshot showing embedded snapshot with broken trace link.

2026-03-10 14:20 - SRE (Marcus Reed): Reproduced locally with internal snapshot-svc: observed link generation step consulted header X-Tracehook on request context but compaction job triggers a proxy that strips certain headers during cold path. 2026-03-11 08:42 - Eng (Priya Nair): Confirmed a regression introduced in console rendering pipeline (PR #4432) that altered header forwarding behavior for headless snapshot renderer. Adding as related PR for tracking. We have a hypothesis and a small patch prepared.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Retention compaction proxy path strips X-Tracehook and similar custom headers during file-backed snapshot transfer (observed in proxy ACL rules).

Hypothesis 2: Recent console rendering change (PR #4432) removed fallback token injection for snapshot exports, relying only on incoming headers being preserved. Regression surfaced only when header-stripping occurred upstream.

Logs: snapshot-svc error stream shows 'missing tracehook token for embed generation' at 2026-03-10T02:33:08Z for snap-2026-03-10-0235. Proxy logs show DROP header X-Tracehook due to rule id proxy-preserve-legacy disabled.

Repro: Local end-to-end replay with compaction proxy enabled reproduced missing query param. Re-run without proxy shows query param present. Patch simulated to re-inject token at render time succeeds in test harness.

Related runbooks: Snapshot Scheduler Runbook (confluence) and Proxy Header Policy (confluence) referenced. Slack thread #support-snapshot contains live debugging notes: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C01SNAPSHOT/1234567890
resolution: Workaround applied: For NimbleHealth only, enabled preserve-header rule for snapshot-scheduler route and temporarily advised scheduling snapshots outside of the compaction window.

Fix planned: Engineering backported a small change to rendering pipeline to inject tracehook token into snapshot payload when missing (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4468). This prevents dependency on upstream header preservation for snapshot exports.

Rollout notes: Patch merged to canary on 2026-03-13, observed 10 successful snapshot runs with trace links preserved. Will promote to prod us-east on 2026-03-14 01:00 UTC with monitoring enabled for 6 hours.

Postmortem action items: (1) Update proxy ACL tests to include custom header preservation checks; (2) add integration test for snapshot render path to fail if tracehook missing; (3) update runbook to include guidance around compaction windows and scheduled snapshot collisions.
Customer communication: Support scheduled a 2026-03-14 10:00 PST call with NimbleHealth to review fix and confirm remedial steps.
